meanings.responsibility: the downstream consumer requests a declarative SDA capability candidate

meanings.experience: either a self-contained projectable source bundle with complete convergence lineage and closure proof, or exact classified findings with complete immutable attempt testimony and no authorized retry, or a held disposition reporting the exact ineligible surface, is returned without handwritten executable code or claims of acceptance

meanings.responsibility: the feature, the blueprint binding, and the selected cell are admitted as canonical source authority

meanings.experience: immutable admitted authoring context and its source lineage are available to the authoring circuit

meanings.responsibility: the required SDA source artifacts, archetypes, permissible ontology vocabulary, and admitted authoring attempt authority are resolved

meanings.experience: a bounded authoring profile fixes the complete declarative candidate surface, the required artifact catalog, and the attempt authority — maximum authoring attempts, maximum repair attempts, provider switch policy, repairable finding classes, retryable provider findings, immutable closed-work policy, and terminal disposition policy — without introducing implementation authority

meanings.responsibility: one artifact authoring ledger is derived from the profile catalog alone

meanings.experience: every required artifact is carried with its required flag, schema authority, dependencies, and pending status, and no artifact is admitted as closed

meanings.responsibility: one work unit is selected from ledger status and dependency state alone

meanings.experience: either one eligible artifact or fragment work unit is selected, or the circuit returns held when work remains and no unit is eligible, reporting the exact ineligible surface

meanings.responsibility: the deterministic authorability preflight evaluates authority closure, authorized mutation scope, representation safety, schema round-trip, provider compatibility, work-unit size and depth limits, dependency closure, and repair and retry authority

meanings.experience: either the work unit is proven authoring-ready with the readiness proof carrying the exact work unit, its disposition, findings, and lineage, or one exact preflight finding — representation unsafe, schema unsatisfiable, context incomplete, provider incompatible, dependency unresolved, mutation scope divergent, or work unit too broad — is reported and no model invocation is authorized

meanings.responsibility: one bounded authoring envelope is constructed for exactly one work unit with the smallest legal response schema compiled for that work unit

meanings.experience: the envelope carries the exact declared capability, scenario, input, input contract, event, event authority, outcome, and outcome contract identities, the unit meaning, incoming and outgoing obligations, permitted dependencies, provider slot, applicable schemas and vocabulary, already-closed referenced fragments, and the constraint to author only this unit

meanings.responsibility: bounded structured testimony is requested for the single selected work unit

meanings.experience: one governed response containing bounded structured testimony and its provider lineage is observed as untrusted testimony

meanings.responsibility: the testimony is prepared into the common admission carrier

meanings.experience: the admission carrier carries the source kind, source digest, work unit identity, attempt identity, and the applicable provider identity or repair authority, without altering any testimony byte

meanings.responsibility: every JSON authority fragment is admitted as a nested structured object, every genuinely textual fragment as text content, and every fragment is independently bound to its declared schema

meanings.experience: either admitted atomic testimony or exact representation-defect findings carrying the raw testimony digest, work unit identity, and attempt identity are available for classification, never as a platform exception; failed admission produces findings and never admitted authority; no content is repaired or assembled without classification

meanings.responsibility: the admission result is classified against the admitted defect classes

meanings.experience: findings are classified as conforming, representation defect, schema defect, vocabulary defect, reference defect, local semantic defect, cross-artifact conflict, scope overreach, missing required product, provider failure, or broadly unusable, and the class alone determines what may happen next

meanings.responsibility: the conforming work unit is established as the integration subject

meanings.experience: the conforming work unit carries the exact work unit identity, its admitted fragment digests, disposition, and lineage for integration

meanings.responsibility: the number of authority-preserving mechanical repairs is resolved

meanings.experience: mechanical repair is authorized only when exactly one authority-preserving repair exists, zero is reported as not mechanically repairable, and more than one is reported as ambiguous with neither repaired mechanically

meanings.responsibility: the unique repair is applied to exactly the affected fragment

meanings.experience: the repaired testimony is returned for re-admission through the same deterministic admission and classification gate, and no other fragment is altered

meanings.responsibility: the work unit is integrated into the artifact authoring ledger with its admitted fragment digests

meanings.experience: the unit is closed, closed work is immutable and is never regenerated without explicit change authority, and every successful attempt reduces the unresolved semantic surface

meanings.responsibility: the admitted attempt authority is applied to the attempt record alone

meanings.experience: either one bounded retry, one provider switch, one bounded repair, or terminal rejection is authorized by authority alone, the model never authorizes its own attempt, and every attempt is retained as immutable testimony with its request digest, response digest, and findings

meanings.responsibility: one bounded repair request is constructed for exactly the affected fragment

meanings.experience: the repair request carries the original immutable testimony, the exact finding, and the exact allowed mutation surface, and closed neighboring authority stays immutable

meanings.responsibility: closed atomic testimony is composed by deterministic ordering and identity rules into the canonical declarative artifacts

meanings.experience: one self-contained projectable SDA source bundle and accumulated authoring lineage are available for closure proof without altering any admitted fact

meanings.responsibility: whole-candidate conformance, blueprint lineage proof, cross-artifact reference proof, and dependency closure are evaluated

meanings.experience: the candidate is eligible for independent admission only after every closure proof passes, and a cross-artifact defect reopens only the affected ledger units for bounded repair

findings.subject: author-tooling-capability-candidate
findings.detail: The separate canonical blueprint is retained exactly, including topology, semantic progress and observability. It is not conflated with the runtime graph.
findings.closure: Qualify a visual profile for the blueprint carrier before projecting its state and responsibility nodes as execution flow.

findings.subject: author-tooling-capability-candidate
findings.detail: Source revelation preserves declarations; human storytelling and visual acceptance are separate.
findings.closure: Review the scenario, claim scope, evidence, human experience and selected animation trace before episode use.

findings.subject: author-tooling-capability-candidate
findings.detail: Native records are preserved and inspectable. Scenario triads are not a simulation of the native execution graph.
findings.closure: Admit explicit visual/trace profiles for native control flow before animating its mechanics.
